features.text: Advanced ROM hinge system with adjustable extension and flexion stops (-10° to 110°)
Multiple locking positions at -10°, 0°, 10°, 20°, 30°, or 40° for controlled recovery
Telescoping design ensures proper fit and alignment throughout rehabilitation
Patient-friendly adjustment tabs allow easy modifications as swelling changes
Available in both cool and full foam options for maximum comfort during recovery

measurement: Available in two adjustable sizes to accommodate most patients. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
